stdout:
Delete comments. Use this tool to delete comments by IDs.

Usage:
  yutu comment delete [flags]

Examples:
# Delete a comment by ID
yutu comment delete --ids abc123
# Delete multiple comments
yutu comment delete --ids abc123,def456

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for delete
  -i, --ids strings   IDs of comments
      --yes           Confirm the operation
